probe: 4-5 GETs per domain (robots.txt, homepage, llms.txt, one same-site sitemap), User-Agent aiagencynet-crawler-check/1.0, no crawler-name probe; with the opt-out rule only robots.txt when it disallows that User-Agent (see runs)

runs.text: A first run checked 1,000 domains on November 26, 2026, before we added an opt-out rule, so all four or five files were requested for each reachable domain.
A second run checked 4,000 domains on November 26, 2026 with that rule: for the 66 whose robots.txt disallows our client, only robots.txt itself was requested.

selection: first 5,000 usable hosts in list order: invalid, reserved, adult or gambling names and subdomains of a listed domain removed; www. stripped
